purpose: A confirmed breakout that persists: at t - breakout_bar == E_expiry the frozen line is retired (EXPIRED_POST_BREAKOUT -> NONE) and the detector recomputes from the available prefix.

params.eps_break_note: eps_break is illustrative, not locked (HD-03, §13.5); versioned/backtestable. This fixture is verified robust across an eps_break sweep — see causal_record.eps_break_robustness.
params.formation_params_note: Formation gates are first-class, k-independent, versioned parameters (§21.3, D-TL-12): min_formation_bars replaces the pivot-derived 2k+2 and min_ath_age_bars replaces the k-recency window. Numerically unchanged at k=3.

expected_second_anchor.reason: Frozen at the confirmed breakout on bar 10 (§21.5): this is the canonical second anchor of the line active at the START of that bar, retained verbatim. No later high may replace it (§21.8).

rejection_rationale.candidate: A confirmed breakout on any bar before t=10
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: No earlier bar in the ACTIVE episode closes above the line that was active at the START of that bar (§13.1 as-of-time).
rejection_rationale.numeric: Closest earlier approach is t=8: ln(C)-y_hat_8(8)-eps_break = -0.03286 < 0.

rejection_rationale.candidate: Re-selecting B* from a high after t=10
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Anchor re-selection is SUSPENDED once the state is BROKEN_OUT/RETESTED; the frozen event line governs failure, retest and expiry (§21.5, §21.8).
rejection_rationale.numeric: 101 later high(s) have a shallower A->high slope than the frozen m=-0.0103126 (e.g. t=10, slope -0.0040822); under a full-series hull one of them would replace B* and could retroactively un-fire the breakout. §21.8 forbids it.

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Formation eligibility is evaluated as-of-time on the available prefix (§21.3): the line becomes ACTIVE only at the first bar satisfying |S_t| >= min_formation_bars AND tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars AND B*_t exists.
rejection_rationale.numeric: t=0: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=0>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=null<=(t-1)-3:FAIL; F3 B*_t exists:FAIL] | t=1: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=1>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:FAIL; F3 B*_t exists:FAIL] | t=2: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=2>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:FAIL; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=3: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=3>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:FAIL; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=4: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=4>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:ok; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=5: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=5>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:ok; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=6: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=6>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:ok; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=7: INSUFFICIENT_BARS [F1 |S_t|=7>=8:FAIL; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:ok; F3 B*_t exists:ok] | t=8: ELIGIBLE [F1 |S_t|=8>=8:ok; F2 tA=0<=(t-1)-3:ok; F3 B*_t exists:ok]

rejection_rationale.candidate: B=(7,92) as second anchor at the formation bar
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: It is not the shallowest envelope-valid descending candidate over the available prefix; the upper log-hull selects the maximum-slope valid candidate (§8, D-TL-04).
rejection_rationale.numeric: slope(A,(7,92)) = -0.0119117 < slope(A,B*) = -0.0103126; B* dominates every bar high in S_8 = bars 0..7 (worst gap 0 <= eps).

key_inequalities: Candidacy is over ALL later bar highs (§6, D-TL-05, HD-11) — never a pivot subset — and every value below is computed from bars strictly EARLIER than the bar it judges (§21.1, HD-12).
Formation (§21.3): t_form = 8 — the first bar with |S_t| >= min_formation_bars = 8 and tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars = (t-1) - 3 and an envelope-valid B*_t.
No re-selection occurs: no bar high ever reaches the active line, so B*_t is constant from formation to the final bar (§21.4 Lemma).
Breakout (§13.1/§13.2): at t=10, ln(C)=4.55388 > y_hat_10(10)=4.50204 + eps_break=0.01 -> margin 0.0418324 log units; confirmed_bar == breakout_bar == 10 (HD-03, no persistence wait).
Expiry (§17): t - breakout_bar = 100 >= E_expiry, measured from the frozen breakout bar and evaluated against the frozen line.
Governing line: A=(0,100), B*=(6,94), m=-0.0103126, b=4.60517 — FROZEN at the breakout bar (§21.5).
geometry_check.notes: Every bar of the post-breakout plateau (high 95.00) is a shallower hull challenger than the frozen B*=(6,94); §21.5 suspends re-selection for the whole BROKEN_OUT episode, so expiry is measured against the frozen line throughout.

causal_record.semantics: As-of-time (rolling causal) evaluation per §21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11. Every value below is derived ONLY from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges; no expectation here uses a full-series hull.

formation.rule: FORMATION_ELIGIBLE(t) iff |S_t| >= min_formation_bars (F1) AND tA <= (t-1) - min_ath_age_bars (F2) AND B*_t exists (F3). Both thresholds are first-class versioned parameters, independent of the pivot window k (§21.3, D-TL-12).

formation.gate_trace_full_caveat: This trace re-evaluates the §21.3 gates statelessly at every bar, INCLUDING bars at which the state is BROKEN_OUT/RETESTED. While the state is frozen (§21.5) re-selection is suspended and no formation occurs, so an "ELIGIBLE" entry after the breakout bar describes gate arithmetic only, not an active line. It also runs to t = bar_count, the line that would judge a hypothetical next bar.

as_of_time_candidate_set.note: Candidacy is over EVERY later bar high (§6, HD-11); pivot status is not consulted. Domination is tested over all bar highs in the prefix (D-TL-05).

pivot_context.definition: isPivotHigh(p,k): strict > against the k bars on the left, >= against the k bars on the right (§5).
pivot_context.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Pivot status is non-authoritative (§5, D-TL-03, HD-11): it never removes a candidate from §6/§8, never changes B*, and never affects formation eligibility (§21.3, D-TL-12). Replacing k here changes nothing in this fixture except this block.

frozen_event_line.binding: Failure (§15), retest (§16) and expiry (§17) are evaluated against THIS line; re-selection is suspended (§21.5).

non_retroactive_challengers.note: Later highs whose A→high slope is shallower than the frozen line. Under a full-series hull they would re-select B*; §21.5/§21.8 forbid it, so the frozen line stands.
